name: Epoch Pack
author: Svector-anu
description: epoch is your unattended software engineer, running inside your aeon instance: spec, build, review, prove and a merge-ready verdict, each pinned to one commit. you merge.

skills.description: turn one intent into a repo map, an optional spec and one runnable work order per unit. plans only, no code.
execute one work order in an isolated checkout, verify it locally and open one pull request. never merges.
review one pull request against its work order at one pinned head sha and post a single gate-accepted receipt.
say whether a pull request is merge-ready: github state plus review and proof receipts at one head sha.
